title: #2 David Leslie, Pyramid Motorsport BMW M3, BTCC 1991
note: Leslie drove #2 at round 13 (Silverstone, October). STR 4711 shows that car plain black with the ESSO-headed number board on the front door (right side), matching the TV graphics drawings (A_v13_15-36_cap_sytner, measured with --compare): board about 16% of the wheelbase wide from just under the window line to the sill, sticker row on the sill. The left side of the round 13 car is not pictured; plain black assumed. Wheels: gold BBS-style mesh with a polished lip, from Sutton 2175990625 and STR 4711/4712; no standing photo of #2 was found (all Pyramid pictures are on track).
